cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Team,

I'm excited to apply for the Social Media Manager position at your company. With a background in digital marketing and hands-on social media coordination, I'm eager to help your clients grow their brand presence across platforms.

At Episto, I manage SEO and content for multiple client websites, which includes writing keyword-targeted blog posts and tracking performance with tools like Google Analytics and SEMrush. This role has sharpened my ability to create engaging content and report on results. On my own project, mirook.com, I designed and built a WordPress site and integrated its Instagram and Facebook accounts. I create posts, respond to comments and messages, and monitor engagement metrics. I also use Canva and AI-assisted tools for basic photo and video editing, ensuring visuals align with the brand.

I have a strong understanding of major social platforms and excellent copywriting skills. I'm creative, detail-oriented, and comfortable managing multiple accounts simultaneously. I collaborate well with designers and am quick to learn new tools. Based in Zwijndrecht, Belgium, I work in English and Turkish, with Dutch at B1 level.

I'm drawn to your young, dynamic team and the opportunity to earn a social media certification while contributing to client success. I'd welcome the chance to discuss how my skills can support your social media efforts.

Thank you for your consideration.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok
+32 470 42 48 36
baverok@gmail.com
linkedin.com/in/baverok
